name: Husn e Mesir Vitamin C Brightening Cream Natural Glow Anti-Blemish Deep Action Formula for Radiant Skin
description:
Husn e Mesir Vitamin C Brightening Cream gives you naturally glowing, radiant skin with every use. Formulated with pure Vitamin C and natural extracts, it helps fade dark spots, remove blemishes, and restore youthful luminosity. Its deep action formula penetrates the skin to provide long-lasting hydration with an oil-free, non-greasy finish. Crafted with care using skin-safe, high-quality ingredients, this cream delivers visible results—leaving your skin bright, smooth, and evenly toned within days.
Key Features:
 Natural Brightening – Gives you a radiant and glowing face
 Reduces Blemishes – Helps remove marks and maintain youthful skin
 Deep Action Formula – Nourishes from within for visible results
 Oil-Free Look – Keeps your skin fresh and shine-free for hours
 Lightweight Texture – Absorbs quickly without clogging pores
 Safe and Natural – Made with high-quality, skin-loving ingredients
How to Use:
 Before going to bed, wash your face with a beauty soap and pat dry
 Apply Husn e Mesir Vitamin C Beauty Cream gently on your face—do not rub hard
 In the morning, wash your face again with beauty soap
 Continue daily for visible results within a few days
Ingredients:
Vitamin C, Natural Extracts, Moisturizing Actives, Brightening Agents, Safe Emollients
Safety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
 Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight
Package Includes:
 1 × Husn e Mesir Vitamin C Brightening Cream
